t: Mi hem sheyyekolim lelek chutz lattechum
s: Mi hem sheyyekolim lelek chutz lattechum ubo g' seipim: mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum mishshum piqquach nepesh, kegon chakama habbaa leyalled vekayyotze bazeh — yesh lo alpayim amma lekol ruach mimmaqom shehiggia lo, kede shello tehe makshilo leatid labo, sheyyimmana millelek im lo yihyeh lo sham ella d' ammot. Veim higgia lair, hare hu keanshe hair, veyesh lo alpayim lekol ruach chutz lair:

Haya yotze birshut vehu holek badderek, veameru lo "kebar naaset hammitzva sheyyatzata laasot" — yesh lo mimmeqomo alpayim lekol ruach. Veim miqtzat hattechum sheyyatza mimmennu birshut hu mubla betok alpayim ellu sheyyesh lo mimmeqomo — hare zeh chozer leiro ukeillu lo yatza, shehablaat hattechumim moelet kesheyyatza birshut, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"h:

Kol hayyotzeim lehatztzil nepashot miyyisrael miyyad nokrim o min hannahar o min hammappolet — yesh lahem alpayim amma lekol ruach mimmaqom shehitztzilu bo. Veim hayeta yad nokrim taqqipa, vehayu mepachadim lishbot bemaqom shehitztzilu bo — hare ellu chozerim beshabbat limqomam ubikle zenam:
